title: The Poké Marts' lists of items: res/field/shops/shops.json
description: The lists of ARCID_SHOP_ITEMS (a/2/8/2) in order, whose lengths are ARCID_SHOP_ITEM_COUNTS (a/2/8/3), which ShopUI_LoadPokeMartItems reads (scrcmd_shop.c). The menu lists a list's items in order, at their price in the item data, and as TMs with their moves if the first is a TM or HM. tools/data/shop_data.py packs them.

badge_marts.description: Files 0 to 5: the Poké Mart whose stock grows with the badges (SHOP_ID_BADGE_MART), the list that BADGE_SHOP_DAT_IDS gives each number of badges: 0 for none, 1 for one or two, 2 for three or four, 3 for five or six, 4 for seven and 5 for all eight

marts.description: Files 6 to 31: the other Poké Marts' lists, by the shop ID that the script's shop command names, its file less 6

special_marts.description: Files 32 to 79: the special marts of SPECIAL_POKE_MART_HEADERS, shop IDs 0xf7 to 0xfa and 0xef to 0xf2 in this order, whose stock grows with KeyDataSave_GetProgress

items.description: The mart's list for each level, the last of sSpecialMartLevels (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10) that the progress reaches
The items the shop sells, in the menu's order; the count is a byte
